WITH budget_line_totals AS (
    SELECT b.budget_id,
           COALESCE(SUM(x.cost), 0) AS total_cost,
           COUNT(x.expense_id) AS expense_count
    FROM budget AS b
    LEFT JOIN expense AS x ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    GROUP BY b.budget_id
),
average_spend AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS avg_total_cost
    FROM budget_line_totals
)
SELECT AVG(blt.total_cost) AS average_total,
       SUM(blt.expense_count) AS expenses_altogether,
       AVG(blt.total_cost - a.avg_total_cost) AS average_excess
FROM budget_line_totals AS blt
CROSS JOIN average_spend AS a
WHERE blt.total_cost > a.avg_total_cost;
